evidence: Touches transaction creation in src/wallet/spend.cpp and adds test coverage in test/functional/wallet_fundrawtransaction.py with the Wallet label.
rationale: Rejecting recipient amounts exceeding MAX_MONEY prevents an int64 overflow that can trigger an assertion crash in RecalculateWaste or wrap around in fundrawtransaction. While fixing crashes on invalid input is worthwhile, passing recipient amounts above 21 million BTC is an edge case in local wallet RPC usage.
